domain_example: recipe app x short-form social video

reusable_pattern.attack: Build distinctive branded/character-led owned content so copied surface information does not erase source preference or affinity.
reusable_pattern.defense: Assume lawful copying/reposting may occur and design source attribution, portable provenance and exclusive utility so redistributed content can still create discoverability without relying on legal threats.
reusable_pattern.engine: Use consented first-party context and contextual signals to reduce friction and recommend the next genuinely useful action across discovery, owned utility and monetization surfaces.

allowed: deep links into useful app state
clear subscription price, renewal and cancellation
provenance markers that survive common repost formats where practical
rejected: making users falsely believe a manipulated choice was independently chosen
covert cross-site tracking without valid consent or lawful basis
dark patterns or deceptive subscription flows
fabricated scarcity or fake social proof
policy evasion or unauthorized access to external browsing history

research_questions: Which creator/brand assets remain valuable after surface content is copied?
Which exclusive utility is valuable enough to create a real return path from social discovery to the owned product?
Which attribution/provenance mechanisms survive reposting and platform transformations?
Which personalization signals can be used lawfully and transparently in each target market?
Which recommendation moments increase user value rather than merely clicks?
Which premium features convert because they remove recurring friction or create durable utility?
Can the loop be reproduced outside recipes in domains with repeat intent and shareable outputs?
